source.name: US Lecce, 'DR Automobiles Groupe è back sponsor di maglia'
source.quote: DR è infatti il nuovo back sponsor di maglia dell’U.S. Lecce.

note: Back-sponsor deal announced 25 Jul 2023, born from the collaboration between club president Saverio Sticchi Damiani and DR Automobiles Groupe president Massimo Di Risio. Still on the shirt in 2026-27 per the club's sponsor page and the official store's product photos. No deal value reported.
